name: Anchor
description: Anchor gives Claude shared artifacts — it can create files and organize them in folders. Read and write files in HTML, Markdown (MD), JSON, CSV and more, design typed tables and query them with SQL. Claude can move files around, make copies and keep everything organized. Every file, table, and folder created is neatly shareable with your team, while Anchor handles storage, permissions, and versioning. Log in once, no API keys, no setup, and let Claude do its magic, only ever touching what you can access.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Anchor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Anchor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.anchor.cc/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Anchor MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Anchor lists 15 MCP tools, including add_table_column, cp, create_table, delete_table_column, describe_table, file_link, file_upload_link, list_orgs, ls, mkdir, mv, and query_table.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Anchor?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Anchor in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Anchor requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Anchor is developed by Anchor Technologies, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
